title: Normalized enrichment result
description: PLANNED — NOT IMPLEMENTED. Target normalized shape for threat-intelligence lookups (VirusTotal, AbuseIPDB) once the enrichment stage is built. The AI SOC Assistant currently performs no enrichment; no node in the shipped workflow produces or consumes this structure. Defined now so example payloads and the future implementation agree. See docs/roadmap.md item 4.

indicator.description: The observable that was looked up.

found.description: False means the provider had no record. Absence of intelligence is not evidence of benignity.

reputation.description: Normalized provider opinion. This is supporting evidence only and never establishes what happened in your environment.

score.description: Provider score normalized to 0-100. Null when the provider returned no score.

detections.description: Multi-engine detection counts, where the provider reports them.

context.description: Provider context that helps an analyst judge relevance.

caveats.description: Machine-readable warnings that must be surfaced with the result, e.g. that the indicator is an RFC 1918 address, a known CDN, or has stale reporting.

raw_provider_reference.description: Permalink to the provider record for analyst verification. Never a raw API response containing a key.
